## Landed
Gerrit change 3175 merged as `344464567ab` with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (CI run 41229077337 on patchset 1, rev `70316a9d5ac`). Gerrit rebased onto `0886e96f03a`; the 2 test files are byte-identical between `70316a9d5ac` and `344464567ab`. Re-ran on the merged tree: `pytest tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py -q` -> 33 passed. AC7 met; all 7 AC boxes ticked. `make verify` was not run locally (another session was using it on this host); CI's Verified vote covers the full `make test` selection, which is what AC7 now names.
